dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible across the dorsal-lateral region. The most prominent structures exhibit a high-contrast transition from bright, jagged outer perimeters to darker, low-intensity interior cores. Edge geometry is non-uniform, with several closed loops showing sharp, high-frequency variations in the boundary width.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: There is a moderate density of small, solid high-intensity pixel clusters localized primarily at the junctions between macro-annuli. These clusters lack an internal gradient and are most concentrated in the mid-dorsal section, becoming sparse towards the posterior and anterior regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest closed-loop annuli in the upper-mid dorsal region form an approximately scalene triangle. A secondary cluster of four high-intensity blobs along the lateral-ventral boundary forms an elongated, slightly curved chain-like configuration.
